acceptance: The project-test shard orchestration serializes only shared Git worktree metadata mutations while preserving configured parallel shard test execution.
When every shard runner writes a passed receipt, the parent project-test-shards target returns success and leaves no registered shard worktree.

When worktree preparation, evidence copy, or cleanup fails, the target fails closed with the shard name, failing phase, and actionable stderr; cleanup does not silently overwrite a preceding shard-runner failure.
Focused automated tests prove serialized worktree mutation, passed-result preservation, and visible cleanup failure behavior.

The template repository Makefile delivers the corrected behavior without changing test selection or quality policy; lifecycle documentation distinguishes template-internal pytest sharding from adopter-defined PROJECT_TEST execution.
The current-Work-Item problem-resolution boundary is explicit in template and installed agent rules, declared as adopter_installed capability surface, and verified by a fresh-adopter parity test.
guidelines: Keep the shard test plan, coverage floor, and quality profile unchanged.
Serialize only Git common-directory mutations; do not serialize the test runner itself.
Do not suppress an orchestration failure that is required to make evidence trustworthy.
Keep the boundary between template-internal pytest sharding and installed adopter PROJECT_TEST execution explicit.

When a problem remains within the current Contract, resolve it in the current Work Item; amend and revalidate before expanding scope, and reserve a new Work Item for a genuinely different or independently governed delivery.
Keep the current-Work-Item resolution boundary identical in the template rules and the installer-delivered adopter rules.
Do not modify or renumber predecessor or merged Hosted archive evidence.

intent.problem: The predecessor implementation was archived on an older base and cannot be rebased because its archive sequence collides with the merged Hosted runner Work Item. The actual quality shard reliability fix still needs to be delivered on current main without rewriting either archived evidence record.
constraints: Do not change shard count, test assignments, coverage floor, or required quality gates.
Keep shard tests parallel; only shared Git worktree metadata operations may be serialized.
Preserve source-bound shard receipts and fail closed on preparation, copy, runner, or cleanup errors.
Keep template-internal pytest sharding distinct from installed adopter PROJECT_TEST execution.
Do not modify or renumber predecessor or merged Hosted archive evidence.
intent.rationale: A clean current-main successor preserves archive immutability while delivering the reliability fix. Deterministic, visible worktree lifecycle handling makes quality evidence trustworthy and removes false parent failures.
